title: Value Iteration
signature: def value_iteration(P: np.ndarray, R: np.ndarray, gamma: float, tol: float = 1e-8) -> tuple
hints: The Bellman backup for every state and action at once is Q = R + gamma * P @ V, because P has shape (S, A, S) and V has shape (S,).
Update all states from the previous V (synchronous). Writing V[s] in place while sweeping states is Gauss-Seidel, which stops at a different iteration.
Stop as soon as max |V_new - V| < tol, and return V_new. Then compute Q from that V_new and take argmax over actions for the policy.
